attribution_limitations: Uterus: the MRI text describes a right-sided rudimentary uterine bud, while Table 2, the Fig. 2 caption and the abstract and conclusion (uterovaginal aplasia or agenesis) describe an absent uterus; the abstract and Fig. 3 caption hedge as hypoplastic or absent. Source conflict on presence of uterine tissue; both sides review_only.

Ovaries: the MRI text says poorly visualized and atrophic appearing, the Fig. 2 caption says not visualized, the discussion says no identifiable ovaries on imaging, and the Table 2 initial evaluation row says absent. Recorded as an ambiguity, not a conflict: poorly visualized or not visualized does not establish presence, and the table does not say whether absent means not seen on imaging or anatomically absent.

Diabetes type (ambiguity, not a conflict): the discussion says type 2 diabetes mellitus, while the case text tested to classify the type, found negative autoantibodies (type 1 not excluded per Table 1) and referred her to rule out monogenic diabetes; MODY is suspected but untested. The type 2 statement is review_only; the MODY suspicion is recorded as a differential.

Table 1 fasting glucose cell gives 126 mg/dL with 8.4 mmol/L, which are not arithmetic equivalents (126 mg/dL is about 7.0 mmol/L). Arithmetic-only mismatch, recorded as an ambiguity; the text confirms 126 mg/dL.
Table 1 random glucose row lists two values (home above 300 mg/dL and 8.72 mmol/L) with one comment, Elevated, and a reference below 11.1 mmol/L; the setting of the second value is unlabeled.

Reference ranges for FSH and TSH differ between the per-test parentheticals and the trailing reference-range note in the same paragraph (FSH 3.5-12.5 vs 3-10 mIU/mL; TSH 0.48-4.17 vs 0.4-4.0 μIU/mL); the abstract repeats the trailing ranges.

Genetic testing status: the discussion first says MODY testing results were still pending, then that the patient and mother did not attend sampling and testing could not be completed; the limitations say sequencing was requested but could not be completed. Recorded as not performed (no sample taken); the pending wording is noted here.

Table 2 places the referral for MODY genetic testing at age 19 with the status Pending/Completed/Not available left unresolved, while the text referral to endocrinology carries no age; they may or may not be the same referral.

Captions describe the urinary bladder as distended (Fig. 2, axial) and as normal in size and shape (Fig. 3, sagittal), different images of the same MRI study; the renal ultrasound also calls the bladder distended.

Metformin and sitagliptin: the source says only that the patient and guardian later consented to initiate them; neither an actual start nor a plan is stated, so action is unknown; dose, route and duration are not stated.
